observation_template.headline: GPH-MILF ceasefire coordination reinforced ahead of the BARMM parliamentary election
observation_template.summary: Philippine Information Agency reported on 9 September 2026 that government representatives, Moro Islamic Liberation Front ground commanders and other stakeholders signed ceasefire-related coordination guidelines and a pledge to promote a peaceful electoral process ahead of the 14 September BARMM parliamentary election. This observation records the institutional coordination as factual pre-election context only; it does not predict election security, integrity, results, peace-process outcomes or market effects, and it does not change the Canonical election date or provenance.

live_evidence.title: GPH-MILF forge commitment to promote peaceful electoral process during the BARMM polls
live_evidence.notes: Official Philippine government information-agency reporting that GPH representatives, MILF ground commanders and other stakeholders signed ceasefire-related coordination guidelines and a pledge for a peaceful electoral process ahead of the 14 September 2026 BARMM parliamentary election. The page does not supply a source-native exact date/time for the signing beyond describing it as recent, so CG does not manufacture event_time.
